name: Secret Film Takane no Hana no Gojitsudan
original_name: シークレットフィルム 高嶺の花の後日談
source: After "coincidentally" running into his former crush, the protagonist asks her to foster two puppies for a while. She happily obliges, but he has ulterior motives which involve hidden cameras to see what she does with her pets behind closed doors.
translation: 在“巧合”地遇到了他以前暗恋的人后，主角让她暂时寄养两只小狗。她很高兴地答应了，但他别有用心，包括隐藏摄像头来看看她关起门来对宠物做了什么。
